desc: 立体鼓包纱布，一张裹住全身，擦完就干爽
name: 薄荷白立体鼓包纱布浴巾款

shots.intent: 搜索首屏一眼看清叠放厚度与鼓包肌理，抓点击。
shots.textZone: 上 20% 中央留白放标题；其下横幅放副标题

shots.intent: 放大擦不干、水珠往下滴的手忙脚乱，制造强吸水需求。
shots.textZone: 左上 30% 区域，标题两行

shots.intent: 用抽象结构对比讲清吸水差异，让卖点可看懂而非空喊。
shots.textZone: 顶部标题带；左右两栏底部各一行标签

shots.intent: 还原出浴当下被一张大巾接住的动线，让妈妈代入使用场景。
用微距证明纱线、格纹与鼓包是真的，杜绝布匹感。
shots.textZone: 右下角标签；左上角一行小标题

shots.intent: 用收边与挂环的做工细节证明不易散边、好收纳。
用悬挂透气的场景传达好洗好干、越用越蓬松的可感知利益。
用可复核的工艺与柔感结构作答，替代任何资质与等级背书。
shots.textZone: 顶部标题带；每行右侧一行标签

shots.intent: 展示多配色可选，把选款决策前移到详情页。
shots.textZone: 顶部中央标题；每个摆台下方一行短标签

shots.intent: 用一张备用同款的收纳画面收口，落到加购与备两条。
shots.textZone: 底部中央两行 + CTA 按钮

style.backgroundSystem: matte white bathtub rim in the foreground and mint-and-white vertical striped ceramic tile behind, seamless shallow depth, no other room context
style.iconSystem: honey-orange #F0A05A thin-line outline icons, 1.5px stroke, rounded caps, water-drop as the recurring motif, flat with no fill or gradient, max 3 icons per screen
style.lightingSystem: bright 5500K top light slightly forward-left as key, large soft front-right fill, one soft-edged contact shadow under the product, airy mood with gentle mint bounce, no harsh specular hotspots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh mint-and-white baby bath commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, pale mint #E4F3EE, mid mint #9FD3C7 and honey-orange accent #F0A05A; neutral 5500K bright top light with soft contact shadows and gentle mint bounce; consistent background system of a matte white bathtub rim and mint-and-white vertical striped ceramic tile; smooth matte glazed ceramic surfaces with soft cotton gauze texture; one modern geometric sans-serif with short Chinese copy in 「」; honey-orange thin-line outline icons with a water-drop motif; stable centered product scale and honest woven cotton gauze with a visible grid and 3D bubble pucker; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no wet or slippery floor, no nude infant and no bathing process.
noDrift: no brand name, store name, logo, watermark, QR code or membership badge
no price, discount, coupon or delivery-time text
no weight, thread count, yarn count, cotton-percentage, size or dimension figures
no age range, certification, test report, award, lab or hospital endorsement
no antibacterial, hypoallergenic, fluorescent-agent-free or grade-tier claims
no origin, import or patent wording
no nude infant and no bathing process; a person appears only as a cropped forearm or hand, or not at all
no wet or slippery floor, no standing water, no splashing
fabric stays woven cotton gauze with a visible warp/weft grid and 3D bubble pucker; never flat sheeting, satin, paper or non-woven cloth
no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no saturated blue-dominant grade
style.presentationRules: product centered on a stable scale across the set, the folded stack keeps honest gauze volume and never collapses into flat cloth, verticals stay vertical, one real scale anchor (ceramic soap dish, tray, pedestal, drying rail) in every scene shot, believable contact shadow so nothing floats
style.surfaceSystem: smooth matte glazed ceramic (tub rim, tile, soap dish, pedestal) contrasted with soft cotton gauze weave; no wet floor, no water sheen on tile, no mirror
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif in medium weight for all headings and labels, Chinese copy kept short inside 「」, #2D2D2D on light zones and #FFFFFF on mint zones, accent labels in #F0A05A
